rationale: CP2 (#736 cpp wave): `TEST(a, b) {...}`, `TEST_F(a, b) {...}` and `BOOST_AUTO_TEST_CASE(x) {...}` parse as function_definitions whose params are bare macro paste-tokens — minting `TEST`/`TEST_F` Function symbols per site (11 in one corpus file) and resolving reads against preprocessor fiction (C-D2). Suppressed: no symbols, no resolution names — but bodies still walk in an anonymous scope (locals bind for shadowing and never leak as file-scope symbols; calls still emit with global source). Real ALL-CAPS functions with typed params are kept (not exercised here by design — the corpus has none).
